messages:
Alex P: Heads-up — starting onboarding for osmosis-xl-70b into staging. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/osmosis-xl/70b/2026-03-15/. Target max_ctx ~65k. Need checks on: kv cache layout, tokenizer pad mapping, and a quick memory floorplan. Who can take which?
Maria K: Quick note — tokenizer for this model uses pad_token_id=32767 in the shipped tokenizer.json. That breaks some of our pad-handling (we normally expect 0). If we feed padded batches some sequences get truncated at the end.
Jamal R: Is the bundle indicating kv format v2 or legacy? I saw metadata.json with "kv_format": "packed" but not explicit v1/v2.
Sasha L: I pulled the archive. metadata shows "kv_format": "packed", kv_dtype: "float16", attention: "gated". Packed -> our runtime treats it like interleaved keys/vals (v2). Good to confirm.
Alex P: @Sasha thanks. Can you run the mem-estimator for 65k and paste numbers? I want to see per-GPU kv bytes and total GPU mem headroom.
Sasha L: Ran quick estimator:```
# mem-estimator --model osmosis-xl-70b --seq 65536 --bsz 1 --kv-format packed
KV cache bytes per token (pair): 48
Total KV bytes (seq*2*8): ~6.29e6 bytes? wait wrong unit... full output:
Estimated KV bytes per GPU: 29.6 GB
Model params (fp16, weights): 35.2 GB
Working set + activations estimate: 8.4 GB
Estimated GPU required ~ 75GB -> need A100-80 or multi-GPU split
```
Maria K: That 29.6GB looks high but plausible for GAU-style heads + 65k seq. Also padding id issue still a blocker for batch tests. I recommend mapping pad_token_id->0 in a serving-time tokenizer override (we can keep original in model card).
Jamal R: For safety we should reduce max_ctx to 50k in runtime profile for staging and add a canary rollout to avoid OOMs. If target customers need 65k we can enable a specialized tall-GPU pool later.
Alex P: Agree. Plan suggestion: 1) Tokenizer patch (map pad->0) in tokenizer.json override for serving. 2) Runtime profile max_seq = 50k for initial staging. 3) Sasha opens PR with mem-estimator output + config change. 4) Jamal runs load-smoke: seq=50k bsz=4 on a 80GB GPU to confirm headroom. 5) Maria runs tokenization sanity tests.
Maria K: Running tokenizer smoke: `python tools/tokenizer_smoke.py --model osmosis-xl --max-len 65536 --cases 10` :hourglass:
Maria K: smoke results: 3/3 tokenization tests passed but one padding edge case where trailing non-space char + pad caused last token loss. Patch ready.
Sasha L: Opening PR now: PR#1428 in infra-models with runtime profile and mem notes. Pinged reviewers @jamal, @alex.
Jamal R: I'll run the load-smoke on staging GPUs in ~10m: `abtest/load_smoke --model osmosis-xl --seq 50000 --bsz 4 --duration 2m` I'll post logs.
infra-bot: Scheduled copy of weights to staging pool (staging-gpu-4) at 2026-03-17T06:00Z.
deploy-bot: Snapshot created for s3://redwood-models/osmosis-xl/70b/2026-03-15/ (snapshot id s-20260315-0810).
Maria K: Tokenizer patch pushed to PR#1429 (tokenizer-fix). I set pad_token_id to 0 and added a compatibility test.
Alex P: Great. Jamal, once you confirm load-smoke stable we'll roll the staged config and run a small canary. If OOMs appear we fallback to 32k max ctx.
Jamal R: Load smoke finished: 120s run, bsz4 seq50k 2/3 workers hit memory pressure spikes but no hard OOM; one process throttled GC. Attaching tail logs: `oom? false`, but mem margin narrow (~1.5GB).
Sasha L: Thanks. Given narrow margin we should enable kv cache sharding flag for this model in staging (`kv_shard_factor: 2`) and keep max_seq 50k. I'll include that in PR#1428.
Alex P: Sounds good. Action items: Sasha PR#1428 (runtime + kv_shard), Maria PR#1429 (tokenizer), Jamal run extended 5m stability test, Alex will review both PRs. Ping me when tests pass and I'll trigger canary rollout. :thumbsup:
